name: Sheet
description: A bottom sheet overlay that slides up from the bottom of the screen. Ideal for mobile-first interactions such as action menus, filters, or supplementary content.

notes: aria-labelledby connects the dialog to the title element.
Body scroll is locked while the sheet is open.
Focus is trapped inside via FocusTrap and restored to the trigger on close.
Clicking the Overlay closes the sheet.

onClose.description: Called when the sheet should close.

title.description: Heading text for the sheet, rendered in the header.

do: Use for mobile-first action menus, filters, or supplementary content.
Always provide a title for accessibility.
Keep sheet content scrollable when it exceeds viewport height.
dont: Do not use Sheet for desktop-only layouts — use Modal or Drawer instead.
Do not nest a Sheet inside another Sheet or Modal.
Do not put critical form flows inside a Sheet — use a full page or Modal.
